title: Telephone area codes
description: Paraguayan landline area codes (0X XX XXX XXX) can be used for region guessing: the first digit indicates the region (e.g. 2 near Asunción, 3 north-east, 4 the Chaco, 5 centre, 6 east, 7 south/Itapúa, 8 Misiones/Ñeembucú). Mobile numbers start with 09; international code +595.
